sections.title: General
sections.blurb: app- and project-level switches the app applies when it builds a launch/spawn plan (startup, updates, power assertions, git integration, housekeeping GC).

sections.title: Appearance
sections.blurb: everything that changes what a session looks like while it runs — theme tokens, glyphs, transcript rendering, image display.

sections.title: Shortcuts & Keys
sections.blurb: how keystrokes and prompt text are interpreted: queue/steering policy, in-prompt keywords, plus the TUI-only input chrome that a GUI replaces.

sections.title: Model & Providers
sections.blurb: the model picker's world: roles and selection, per-model thinking and sampling, vision handling, tiny/utility models, provider services and wire protocol.

sections.title: Agent
sections.blurb: what the agent is told and what it may do: system-prompt composition, approval policy, tool enablement and limits, file read/edit behaviour, isolation, subagents.

sections.title: Context & Compaction
sections.blurb: context-window policy and automatic maintenance, including the stream rules that interrupt a run mid-flight.

sections.title: Memory
sections.blurb: memory backends and their recall/retain pipelines, grouped by backend so a user configures one memory system, not five.

sections.title: Skills
sections.blurb: loading and discovery of skills and foreign command directories — the prompt-asset trust boundary.

sections.title: MCP
sections.blurb: MCP server loading and the notification/debounce behaviour of MCP results.

sections.title: LSP
sections.blurb: language-server lifecycle and the diagnostics/format hooks the agent's write path calls.

sections.title: Session
sections.blurb: session-scoped modes and roots: plan/goal (deferred), branch summaries, title refresh, resume, extra workspace roots.

sections.title: Terminal & Shell
sections.blurb: the agent's own execution environment — bash, eval/python runtimes, and the output compressor that sits in front of them.

sections.title: Notifications
sections.blurb: when the app announces something: turn completion, errors, blocking questions, idle recaps (plus the deferred voice feature, kept in one place until it ships).

sections.title: Usage & Limits
sections.blurb: what happens when the account or the network pushes back: retries, fallbacks, service tiers, saved-reset redemption, stream and concurrency limits.

sections.title: Advanced
sections.blurb: infrastructure and experiments: image publishing, the deferred collaboration/relay stack, commit-engine tuning, telemetry, credential plumbing, extension loading.

sections.title: Raw config
sections.blurb: not a settings section but a screen: the escape hatch for the 191 `hidden`/`deferred` keys, for keys OMP adds after this pin, and for reproducing a bug report. Defined in §"Raw config escape hatch".

keys.label: Auto Resume
keys.description: Automatically resume the most recent session in the current directory

keys.label: Quiet Startup
keys.description: Skip welcome screen and startup status messages

keys.label: Show Startup Splash
keys.description: Show the full animated setup splash on normal interactive startup without rerunning setup. Quiet Startup still suppresses it.

keys.label: Setup Wizard
keys.description: Show newly added onboarding steps once per setup version

keys.label: Check for Updates
keys.description: Check for omp updates on startup

keys.label: Update Channel
keys.description: Update channel used by omp update and the startup update check

keys.label: Marketplace Auto-Update
keys.description: Check for plugin updates on startup

keys.label: Startup Changelog
keys.description: Choose whether update notes start as a summary, full details, or stay hidden

keys.label: Sleep Prevention
keys.description: Prevent the system sleeping during active sessions. Each level is cumulative — it adds the flags of all lower levels.

keys.label: Enable Git Integration
keys.description: Show git branch, status, and PR information in the TUI and watch repository metadata.

keys.label: Dark Theme
keys.description: Theme used when the terminal has a dark background

keys.label: Light Theme
keys.description: Theme used when the terminal has a light background

keys.label: Symbol Preset
keys.description: Glyph set for icons and symbols (Unicode, Nerd Font, or ASCII)

keys.label: Color-Blind Mode
keys.description: Use blue instead of green for diff additions

keys.label: Composer Shape
keys.description: Visual layout of the input editor and status line

keys.label: Generation Rate
keys.description: Show a live generation tok/s readout on the working row, docked right next to the session title. Estimated from streamed deltas and corrected by the provider's billed output count as each message completes.

keys.label: Status Line Preset
keys.description: Pre-built status line configurations

keys.label: Status Line Separator
keys.description: Style of separators between segments

keys.label: Context-Reactive Line
keys.description: How the line between the left and right segments reflects context usage (box composer only)

keys.label: Session Accent
keys.description: Use the session name color for the editor border and status line gap

keys.label: Transparent Status Line
keys.description: Use the terminal's default background for the status line instead of the theme's `statusLineBg`. Powerline end caps are dropped because they need a contrasting fill to bridge into the surrounding terminal.

keys.label: Compact Thinking Level
keys.description: Show the thinking level as a single icon on the model name instead of a separate ` · <level>` suffix.

keys.label: Show Hook Status
keys.description: Display hook status messages below the status line

keys.label: Show Inline Images
keys.description: Render images inline in the terminal

keys.label: Auto-Resize Images
keys.description: Resize large images to 2000x2000 max for better model compatibility

keys.label: Block Images
keys.description: Prevent images from being sent to LLM providers

keys.label: Resize Scrollback
keys.description: How a settled terminal resize refreshes transcript rows retained in terminal scrollback

keys.label: Native Terminal Progress
keys.description: Emit OSC 9;4 indeterminate progress while the agent or context maintenance is running

keys.label: Large Headings (Kitty)
keys.description: Render Markdown H1 headings at 2x scale using Kitty's OSC 66 text-sizing protocol. Only takes effect on Kitty terminals; ignored everywhere else. Off by default.

keys.label: Render Mermaid Diagrams
keys.description: Render Mermaid fenced code blocks as ASCII diagrams

keys.label: Agent Reactions
keys.description: Invite the agent to react to your message with an emoji badge on its bubble

keys.label: Codex Reset Fireworks
keys.description: Celebrate unscheduled Codex weekly usage resets and newly banked saved resets with a top-third fireworks overlay that remains until Escape

keys.label: Terminal Title Run State
keys.description: Show the agent run state in the terminal title's separator — an animated spinner while working (a static ':' under WSL), '>' when it's your turn, '!' when the agent is waiting on you

keys.label: Terminal Title Spinner
keys.description: Glyph set for the working-state spinner in the terminal title — braille sweep, filling moon, single-dot cycle, or ASCII-safe line

keys.label: Terminal Hyperlinks
keys.description: Wrap paths and URLs in OSC 8 hyperlinks for terminal-native click-to-open (auto: detect support; off: never; always: unconditional)

keys.label: Mouse Click-to-Focus
keys.description: Capture mouse clicks in the main session so live subagent cards and HUD rows focus on click, with a hover highlight on the target. Native text selection becomes Shift+drag and wheel scroll becomes Shift+wheel while on

keys.label: Tight Layout
keys.description: Remove the 1-character horizontal padding from the left and right of the terminal output

keys.label: Shimmer
keys.description: Animation style for working/loading messages

keys.label: Pinned Agents
keys.description: Pinned live-agent jump list above the editor (off hides it; collapsed shows a few rows with an expander; full lists all)

keys.label: Smooth Streaming
keys.description: Reveal assistant text and streamed tool input smoothly while chunks arrive

keys.label: Hide Tool Activity
keys.description: Hide model-initiated tool calls and results from the transcript

keys.label: Show Token Usage
keys.description: Show per-turn token usage on assistant messages

keys.label: Show Turn Time
keys.description: Show the total prompt-to-yield time (including tool calls) on assistant message usage rows

keys.label: Cache Miss Marker
keys.description: Show a divider after an assistant turn whose request lost (missed) the prompt cache

keys.label: Collapse Compacted History
keys.description: Collapse pre-compaction history behind the summary divider on the live transcript; disable to keep the full transcript inline with dividers at each compaction point

keys.label: Show Hardware Cursor
keys.description: Show terminal cursor for IME support

keys.label: IME-Safe Prompt Layout
keys.description: Move the prompt's bottom border to a separate row so macOS IME preedit cannot displace it

keys.label: Show Resolved Model Badge
keys.description: Display the actual model ID used by each subagent in the task widget status line

keys.label: Steering Mode
keys.description: How to process queued messages while agent is working

keys.label: Follow-Up Mode
keys.description: How to drain follow-up messages after a turn completes

keys.label: Interrupt Mode
keys.description: When steering messages interrupt tool execution

keys.label: Vim Editing Mode
keys.description: Modal prompt editing. Escape leaves Insert mode; Normal mode has hjkl, 0, $, ^, w, b, e, gg, G, counts, x/D/C, dd/yy, p and u; operators take motions or text objects (diw, ca(, dap); v/V start a Visual selection that y copies and d deletes

keys.label: Vim Mode Indicator
keys.description: How the current Vim mode appears in the status line

keys.label: Loop Mode
keys.description: What happens between /loop iterations before re-submitting the prompt

keys.label: Loop Condition Timeout (ms)
keys.description: Max wait for a `/loop --while` / `--until` condition command before treating it as broken and stopping the loop. Set to 0 to wait indefinitely

keys.label: Recall Cleared Drafts
keys.description: Keep drafts cleared with Ctrl+C in local Up/Down history until exit; disabling affects future clears

keys.label: Double-Escape Action
keys.description: What pressing Escape twice with an empty editor does: open the transcript rewind selector, open the session tree, or nothing

keys.label: Session Tree Filter
keys.description: Default filter mode when opening the session tree

keys.label: Autocomplete Items
keys.description: Max visible items in autocomplete dropdown (3-20)

keys.label: Typo Detection (macOS)
keys.description: Mark misspelled prompt words with the active macOS dictionaries

keys.label: Word Autocomplete (macOS)
keys.description: Show macOS dictionary word completions as inline hints accepted with Tab

keys.label: Autocorrect (macOS)
keys.description: Apply confident macOS spelling corrections after completed words

keys.label: Emoji Autocomplete
keys.description: Suggest emojis from `:name:` shortcodes and expand text emoticons like `:D` or `:-)`

keys.label: Large Paste Menu
keys.description: When a paste reaches this many lines, offer a menu to wrap it in a code block, wrap it in XML tags, or save it to a file. 0 disables the menu (large pastes still collapse to a [Paste] marker).

keys.label: Magic Keywords
keys.description: Enable hidden notices for standalone ultrathink, orchestrate, and workflowz keywords

keys.label: Ultrathink Keyword
keys.description: Let standalone ultrathink request maximum automatic thinking and append its hidden notice

keys.label: Orchestrate Keyword
keys.description: Let standalone orchestrate append its hidden multi-agent orchestration notice

keys.label: Workflow Keyword
keys.description: Let standalone workflowz append its hidden eval workflow notice

keys.label: Enable Advisor
keys.description: Pair a second model (assigned to the 'advisor' role) that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.

keys.label: Advisor Sync Backlog
keys.description: Pause the main agent for up to 30 seconds if the advisor falls behind by this many turns. Off disables catch-up delays.

keys.label: Advisor Immune Turns
keys.description: After an advisor concern or blocker interrupts, route further concerns/blockers non-interruptingly for this many primary turns.

keys.label: Advisor Max Notes Per Update
keys.description: Maximum non-blocker advice notes accepted per advisor prompt update (1–32; UI offers 1–5 quick picks). Blockers are exempt.

keys.label: Enable Prewalk
keys.description: Start on the active model, then switch to a fast/cheap model (default the 'smol' role) at the first edit/write after the plan nudge's todo list exists — the strong model plans, commits the todos, and starts the implementation before handing off. Overridable per session with --prewalk / --no-prewalk.

keys.label: Describe Images for Text Models
keys.description: When an image is attached to a model without vision support, save it under local:// and inject a description from a vision-capable model instead of dropping it

keys.label: Thinking Level
keys.description: Reasoning depth for thinking-capable models

keys.label: Hide Thinking Blocks
keys.description: Hide thinking blocks in assistant responses

keys.label: Prose Only Thinking
keys.description: Omit code blocks from thinking summaries and replace them with an ellipsis

keys.label: Omit Thinking summaries
keys.description: Instruct upstream providers to completely omit thinking summaries from responses (where supported)

keys.label: External Thinking
keys.description: Private scratchpad; not shown to user. Disables supported GPT, Claude, and Gemini reasoning

keys.label: Loop Guard
keys.description: Enable automatic stream loop detection for model reasoning and prose

keys.label: Loop Guard Scan Prose
keys.description: Apply loop guard to assistant prose messages in addition to thinking logs

keys.label: Loop Guard Tool-Call Reminder
keys.description: When a Gemini reasoning stream emits many consecutive planning headers without calling a tool, interrupt it and inject a reminder to issue a tool call (requires Loop Guard)

keys.label: Tool-Call Loop Guard
keys.description: Detect consecutive identical tool calls across turns and inject a corrective steer

keys.label: Tool-Call Loop Threshold
keys.description: Consecutive identical tool calls required before the corrective steer is injected

keys.label: Tool-Call Loop Exempt Tools
keys.description: Tool names that may repeat consecutively without triggering the cross-turn loop guard

keys.label: Auto Thinking Model
keys.description: Difficulty classifier for the `auto` thinking level: online (the TINY role from /models, else smol) by default, or a local on-device model

keys.label: Auto Thinking Ceiling
keys.description: Highest effort the `auto` classifier may resolve. `xhigh` keeps the classifier one tier below the top, so only an explicit `ultrathink` reaches `max`; `max` lets a turn the classifier judges exceptional bill the top tier on models that expose it.

keys.label: Temperature
keys.description: Sampling temperature (0 = deterministic, 1 = creative, -1 = provider default)

keys.label: Top P
keys.description: Nucleus sampling cutoff (0-1, -1 = provider default)

keys.label: Top K
keys.description: Sample from top-K tokens (-1 = provider default)

keys.label: Min P
keys.description: Minimum probability threshold (0-1, -1 = provider default)

keys.label: Presence Penalty
keys.description: Penalty for introducing already-present tokens (-1 = provider default)

keys.label: Repetition Penalty
keys.description: Penalty for repeated tokens (-1 = provider default)

keys.label: Text Verbosity
keys.description: OpenAI Responses and Codex response verbosity (low, medium, or high)

keys.label: Web Search Provider Order
keys.description: Prioritized providers for the web_search tool; unlisted providers retain their default order afterward

keys.label: Excluded Web Search Providers
keys.description: Providers that web_search should never use, even as fallbacks

keys.label: Web Search Timeout
keys.description: Hard timeout for each provider's search transport before web_search advances to the next fallback, in seconds (maximum 300)

keys.label: Gemini web_search model
keys.description: Model ID for Gemini Google Search grounding. Defaults to gemini-2.5-flash.

keys.label: Antigravity Endpoint Mode
keys.description: Endpoint routing strategy for google-antigravity providers (chat, search, image, discovery)

keys.label: Image Provider Order
keys.description: Prioritized providers for image generation; unlisted providers follow the active session provider and the built-in order

keys.label: Live Voice
keys.description: Voice used by Codex-backed realtime voice sessions

keys.label: Text-to-Speech Provider
keys.description: Backend for the tts tool: local on-device neural TTS (Kokoro-82M), xAI Grok Voice, or DeepInfra speech

keys.label: Local TTS Model
keys.description: On-device neural TTS model (Kokoro-82M) used by the local TTS backend

keys.label: Local TTS Voice
keys.description: Kokoro voice used by the local TTS backend (American/British, female/male)

keys.label: Fetch Provider
keys.description: Reader backend priority for the fetch/read URL tool

keys.label: Exa
keys.description: Enable the Exa web search provider

keys.label: Exa Search Delay
keys.description: Minimum delay between Exa web search requests in milliseconds; set 0 to disable pacing

keys.label: SearXNG Endpoint
keys.description: Base URL of a self-hosted SearXNG instance used for web search

keys.label: Codex Code Mode
keys.description: Route Codex code_mode_only models (GPT-5.6) through eval. The direct tools are eval, ask, todo, yield, think, checkpoint, and rewind. Use eval cells for other session tools. Mirrors codex-rs Code Mode. 'auto' follows the model catalog flag.

keys.label: Codex Code Mode Direct Tools
keys.description: Extra direct tools for Codex Code Mode. The standard direct tools are eval, ask, todo, yield, think, checkpoint, and rewind.

keys.label: Judgment Provider
keys.description: Preferred backend for typed judgments (auto-thinking difficulty, Smart unexpected-stop detection, git AI staging, eval judge()). Auto uses TypeSafe when authenticated; failed TypeSafe requests fall back through tiny, smol, default, then the active session model.

keys.label: Tiny Model
keys.description: Session-title model: online (the TINY role from /models, else @smol) by default, or a local on-device model

keys.label: Tiny Model Device
keys.description: Inference backend for local tiny models (titles + memory): an ONNX execution provider, or `mlx` to download MLX weights and run them through mlx-lm on Apple silicon. Default uses CPU-only ONNX. The PI_TINY_DEVICE env var overrides this.

keys.label: Tiny Model Precision
keys.description: ONNX quantization/precision for local tiny models. Default uses each model's shipped dtype (q4); lower precision is faster, higher is more faithful. Ignored by the MLX backend (its repos are pre-quantized 4-bit). The PI_TINY_DTYPE env var overrides this.

keys.label: Unexpected Stop Model
keys.description: Classifier for Smart unexpected-stop detection: online (the TINY role from /models, else smol) by default, or a local on-device model.

keys.label: Kimi API Format
keys.description: API format for Kimi Code provider (auto follows live model metadata)

keys.label: OpenAI WebSockets
keys.description: Websocket policy for OpenAI Codex models (auto uses model defaults, on forces, off disables)

keys.label: Prompt Cache Retention
keys.description: Prompt-cache retention forwarded to providers that support it (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenRouter, OpenAI)

keys.label: OpenRouter Routing
keys.description: Default routing-variant suffix appended to OpenRouter model IDs (overridden when the selector already names a variant)

keys.label: Append-Only Context
keys.description: Cache system prompt + tool specs and keep an append-only message log so provider prefix caches (DeepSeek, Xiaomi/SGLang, Anthropic) hit at maximum rate. Auto enables for known prefix-cache providers.

keys.label: Model Role Storage
keys.description: Where model selector role assignments are saved

keys.label: Inline Tool Descriptors
keys.description: Render full tool descriptors in the system prompt and strip top-level/nested descriptions from provider tool schemas so descriptor text is sent once. Auto enables this for Gemini models and disables it otherwise

keys.label: Include Model in Prompt
keys.description: Surface the active model identifier in the system prompt so the agent knows which model it is

keys.label: Include Workspace Tree
keys.description: Render the workspace directory tree in the system prompt. WARNING: This can bust prompt caching across sessions when files are modified.

keys.label: List Skills in Prompt
keys.description: List available skills in the system prompt; disable to save context and toggle per-session with /skillful

keys.label: Personality
keys.description: Communication style rendered into the system prompt's personality block

keys.label: Tool Approval Policies
keys.description: Per-tool approval policies. Set to 'allow' to auto-approve, 'prompt' to require confirmation, or 'deny' to block. Overrides are honored in every approval mode.

keys.label: Tool Approval
keys.description: Default approval behavior for tool calls. 'Always ask' auto-approves read-only tools only. 'Write' auto-approves read and workspace-write tools. 'Yolo' auto-approves all tiers; user policy may still prompt or block.

keys.label: Unexpected Stops
keys.description: Automatically recover when the assistant stops without a visible message. Smart also classifies text-only stops with a small model.

keys.label: Tool Calling Mode
keys.description: Controls how tools are exposed to the model. Auto uses provider-native tool calls unless the selected model is marked as not supporting them, then falls back to the GLM owned dialect. Native forces provider-native tools; the other values force the named owned dialect. Applies on session start.

keys.label: Edit Mode
keys.description: Select the edit tool variant (replace, patch, hashline, or apply_patch)

keys.label: Fuzzy Match
keys.description: Accept high-confidence fuzzy matches for whitespace differences

keys.label: Fuzzy Match Threshold
keys.description: Similarity threshold (0-1) for accepting fuzzy matches

keys.label: Abort on Failed Preview
keys.description: Abort streaming edit tool calls when patch preview fails

keys.label: Recover Inline Edit Payloads
keys.description: Execute edit payloads the model emits as plain text by converting them into edit tool calls

keys.label: Block Auto-Generated Files
keys.description: Prevent editing of files that appear to be auto-generated (protoc, sqlc, swagger, etc.)

keys.label: Enforce Seen-Line Guard
keys.description: Reject edits anchored on lines a prior read/search never displayed in full

keys.label: Record Parse Regressions
keys.description: Append full before/after source when an edit introduces an AST parse failure

keys.label: Auto-Repair Parse Regressions
keys.description: When an edit breaks a file's AST parse, ask the smol model to fix the broken region (validated by re-parse; falls back to a warning)

keys.label: Line Numbers
keys.description: Prepend line numbers to read tool output by default

keys.label: Default Read Limit
keys.description: Default number of lines returned when agent calls read without a limit

keys.label: Markdown Previews
keys.description: Render Markdown read results as formatted terminal Markdown previews instead of raw source

keys.label: Inline Read Previews
keys.description: Render read tool results inline in the transcript instead of summary rows

keys.label: Read Summaries
keys.description: Return structural code summaries when read is called without an explicit selector

keys.label: Prose Summaries
keys.description: Return structural summaries for Markdown and plain text reads

keys.label: Read Summary Body Lines
keys.description: Minimum multiline body or literal length before read summaries collapse it

keys.label: Read Summary Comment Lines
keys.description: Minimum multiline block comment length before read summaries collapse it

keys.label: Read Summary Minimum File Length
keys.description: Files with fewer total lines are read verbatim instead of structurally summarized

keys.label: Read Summary Unfold Target
keys.description: BFS-unfold elidable spans until the summary is at least this many visible lines. 0 keeps only the outermost elisions.

keys.label: Read Summary Unfold Ceiling
keys.description: Hard ceiling on summary size while BFS-unfolding. An unfold whose revealed lines would exceed this is skipped (that span stays folded) and unfolding continues with the remaining spans.

keys.label: Artifact Spill Threshold (KB)
keys.description: Tool output above this size is saved as an artifact; tail is kept inline

keys.label: Artifact Tail Size (KB)
keys.description: Amount of tail content kept inline when output spills to artifact

keys.label: Artifact Head Size (KB)
keys.description: Amount of head content kept inline alongside the tail when output spills to artifact (middle elision). 0 disables — keep tail only.

keys.label: Output Column Cap
keys.description: Per-line byte cap for streaming tool outputs (bash, python, js eval) and `read`. Lines wider than this are ellipsis-truncated; remaining bytes up to the next newline are dropped. 0 disables.

keys.label: Artifact Tail Lines
keys.description: Maximum lines of tail content kept inline when output spills to artifact

keys.label: Todos
keys.description: Enable the todo tool for task tracking

keys.label: Glob
keys.description: Enable the glob tool for glob-based file lookup

keys.label: Grep
keys.description: Enable the grep tool for regex content search

keys.label: AST Grep
keys.description: Enable the ast_grep tool for structural AST search

keys.label: AST Edit
keys.description: Enable the ast_edit tool for structural AST rewrites

keys.label: Debug
keys.description: Enable the debug tool for DAP-based debugging

keys.label: Launch
keys.description: Enable the launch tool for supervising shared long-running project processes

keys.label: Speech Generation
keys.description: Enable the tts tool for on-device (Kokoro) or xAI Grok Voice speech-file synthesis

keys.label: Generate Image
keys.description: Enable the generate_image tool (text-to-image generation and editing). Exposed as an xd:// device when tools.xdev is on.

keys.label: Computer
keys.description: Enable the scriptable host-desktop eval prelude (screenshots, input, accessibility)

keys.label: Checkpoint/Rewind
keys.description: Enable the checkpoint and rewind tools for context checkpointing

keys.label: Read URLs
keys.description: Allow the read tool to fetch and process URLs

keys.label: Obsidian Vault
keys.description: Enable the vault:// internal URL for reading and editing Obsidian vault content via the Obsidian CLI. When disabled, vault:// resolution is refused and the vault:// entry is omitted from the system prompt.

keys.label: GitHub CLI
keys.description: Enable the github tool (op-based dispatch for repository, issue, pull request, diff, search, checkout, push, and Actions watch workflows)

keys.label: Web Search
keys.description: Enable the web_search tool for live web results

keys.label: Security
keys.description: Enable OMP-native security scan planning, execution, and the read-only security:// resource namespace

keys.label: Ask
keys.description: Enable the ask tool for interactive user questions

keys.label: Browser
keys.description: Enable the browser eval prelude for scripted Chromium automation (Puppeteer)

keys.label: Todo Reminders
keys.description: Remind the agent to complete todos before stopping

keys.label: Todo Reminder Limit
keys.description: Maximum number of todo reminders before giving up

keys.label: Create Todos Automatically
keys.description: How strongly to push automatic todo-list creation after the first message

keys.label: Todo Auto-Clear Delay
keys.description: Delay before completed or abandoned todos are removed from the todo widget

keys.label: Grep Context Before
keys.description: Lines of context before each grep match

keys.label: Grep Context After
keys.description: Lines of context after each grep match

keys.label: Browser CDP URL
keys.description: Default HTTP CDP discovery endpoint (for example http://127.0.0.1:9222) to attach to instead of launching a browser. Explicit app.cdp_url or app.path on the tool call take precedence.

keys.label: Browser Relay
keys.description: Drive your own Chrome tabs through the omp browser relay. Install the extension once (`omp browser-relay install`); the relay server auto-starts when the browser prelude needs it. Takes precedence over Browser CDP URL; set PI_BROWSER_RELAY=0 or PI_BROWSER_RELAY=1 to override.

keys.label: Browser Relay URL
keys.description: omp browser relay endpoint (default http://127.0.0.1:9224).

keys.label: Headless Browser
keys.description: Launch browser in headless mode (disable to show browser UI)

keys.label: cmux Browser
keys.description: Use cmux WKWebView surfaces for browser automation when a cmux socket is available. Set PI_BROWSER_CMUX=0 or PI_BROWSER_CMUX=1 to override.

keys.label: Freeze Browser Tabs On Turn End
keys.description: Freeze OMP-owned headless browser tabs when a turn settles so animated pages stop burning CPU/GPU while idle. Tabs unfreeze automatically on next use; pass persist:true on open to opt a tab out.

keys.label: Browser Idle Close Timeout
keys.description: Close OMP-owned headless browser tabs idle longer than this many seconds (0 = never; session dispose still reaps). Applies only to OMP-launched headless tabs, never relay/CDP/spawned browsers or other sessions' tabs.

keys.label: Screenshot Directory
keys.description: Directory to save screenshots. If unset, screenshots go to a temp file. Supports ~. Examples: ~/Downloads, ~/Desktop, /sdcard/Download (Android)

keys.label: Computer Display
keys.description: Composite all displays or select a native display id

keys.label: Computer Screenshot Width
keys.description: Maximum composite screenshot width in pixels

keys.label: Computer Screenshot Height
keys.description: Maximum composite screenshot height in pixels

keys.label: Image Question Timeout
keys.description: Per-request timeout for the vision-model call behind read's ?q= image questions, in milliseconds. A stalled provider fails fast with a timeout error instead of blocking until manual abort. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.

keys.label: Intent Tracing
keys.description: Ask the agent to describe the intent of each tool call before executing it

keys.label: Abort On Fabricated Tool Result
keys.description: With in-band tool calls, stop the model immediately when it starts hallucinating a tool result mid-turn. Disable to let the model finish generating and discard the fabricated continuation instead.

keys.label: Experimental Speculative Execution
keys.description: Enable the discard-safe first slice: validated local reads through direct read calls and nested eval. Network requests, provider completions, and live filesystem writes are not part of this baseline.

keys.label: Speculative Execution Concurrency
keys.description: Maximum number of validated local reads allowed to run before normal dispatch.

keys.label: Max Tool Timeout
keys.description: Maximum timeout in seconds the agent can set for any tool (0 = no limit)

keys.label: Async Execution
keys.description: Enable async bash commands and background task execution

keys.label: IRC Timeout
keys.description: Timeout for hub send await:true in milliseconds; 0 disables the timeout

keys.label: GitHub View Cache
keys.description: Cache rendered issue/PR view output in ~/.omp/cache/github-cache.db so repeated reads are free

keys.label: GitHub Cache Soft TTL

Model-oriented keys apply whenever that model/provider is active, regardless of role; a "provider/*" entry keeps the failing model's id and swaps the provider. An id-prefixed wildcard ("openrouter/google/*") re-prefixes the failing model's bare id (google-antigravity/gemini-x -> openrouter/google/gemini-x) and, used as a key, matches only that provider's ids under the prefix. A fallback entry may carry an explicit thinking suffix ("provider/model:low", ":high", ":max", ":off"); a bare entry inherits the failing turn's effort, and "provider/*" entries always inherit.

danger.why: A single selection is a global bypass: OMP's schema default is `yolo` (`05` §6, `settings-schema.ts:4130`), and a GUI that renders the enum as an ordinary select can turn every approval off in one click. v1 exposes exactly three modes (`always-ask`/`write`/`yolo`) through the Mode menu with its own confirmation (`11` D4), and the app writes the key plus the `--approval-mode` spawn flag — never a settings row.

A bulk editor for per-tool `allow`/`prompt`/`deny` is a bypass surface for the whole tool set. The app writes single entries from the approval dialog's "always allow", so the decision stays attached to the call that produced it (`11` §1 consequences). **Measured at v18.2.6, the write is not live**: a running session keeps asking after the record changes, and a session started afterwards does not — so this row is `sidecar restart`, not `next call`, and the dialog says so rather than promising an immediate effect (`12` §10).
Ordered auto-approval rules for bash with `*` wildcards (`05` §2.7). A loose pattern approves arbitrary command shapes without a dialog, and the failure is invisible until it matters.
Evaluates literal `&&` chains per command, changing the approval granularity from one command to many (`settings-schema.ts:3915`, `Bash` group) — a policy change disguised as a convenience toggle.
Regex rules that rewrite bash commands into other tools; a wrong rule changes *what actually ran*, not just what was approved.
An arbitrary shell binary executed for every bash tool call.
An arbitrary Python executable; setting it also skips runtime discovery entirely.
Module paths loaded into the sidecar process — arbitrary code, by construction.
Deny-list only: writing it cannot remove a malicious path a user already added elsewhere, so surfacing it invites false confidence.
